اقتحمتما (form VIII)
# اِقْتَحَمْتُمَا (iqtaḥamtumā) /iq.ta.ħam.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
# اُقْتُحِمْتُمَا (uqtuḥimtumā) /uq.tu.ħim.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
